summary: @servicetitan/marketing-form 0.1.8 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip (pinned v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. The downloaded runtime is not hash- or signature-verified. math_init.js is a 727KB file carrying a '// @bun @bun-cjs' header and heavy string-array/char-code obfuscation (rotated numeric array, WV8StW rotation function, hex-obfuscated identifiers) whose contents cannot be statically deobfuscated. The filename 'math_init' is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (React marketing-form helpers). Using an out-of-band JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled blob at install time bypasses Node-based inspection and matches the alternate-runtime dropper shape: fetch a non-Node runtime, then execute attacker-controlled bytes shipped alongside the package. This fires automatically on `npm install` before any user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
